title: Metal Forge
body:
"Sheesh! That's hot. This machine is a lot more improved compared to that rusty forge! Same usage, as always."


Description

The Steel Forge is the second obtainable tier of forges. It can be found and purchased at The Oak Depot. Like the Rusty Forge, It is used to smelt refined ores/rocks (which can be done through a refinery) into forged ingots/rocks by putting them through its conveyor, but can smelt larger ores/rocks than the Rusty Forge.

Appearance

The forge has a different shape than the Rusty Forge, and is made of a light gray metal, along with frames to support it.
